Commenting on the landmark financial results and strategic progress,
Mr. Nikhil Chaturvedi, Managing Director, Prozone Realty Limited

"Q2 FY27 represents a watershed moment in Prozone Realty's corporate evolution. The successful realization of our retail asset monetization strategy through the transaction with Inorbit Malls has yielded an exceptional gain of over ₹61,500 lakhs, radically expanding our net worth and liquidity reserves.

This transaction accomplishes our core objective: unlocking deep embedded value from our mature commercial assets and establishing a fortress balance sheet. With virtually zero debt constraints holding back our growth, we are aggressively redeploying capital toward scaling up our high-margin residential projects and maximizing returns from our strategically retained land banks. We remain deeply committed to generating enduring, long-term value for all our stakeholders."

Prozone Realty Limited (formerly Prozone Intu Properties Limited) is a premier publicly listed real estate developer focused on designing, developing, and managing world-class retail shopping centers, commercial hubs, and large-scale residential townships across high-growth Indian urban centers.
